title: Trace and point classes on a regular proper curve over a separably closed field
statement: Let $k$ be a separably closed field [def-pc-separably-closed], let $D$ be a regular integral proper $k$-scheme of dimension $1$ [def-weil-regular-scheme, def-pc-integral-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], and let $\ell$ be prime, $n\geq1$ and $\Lambda=\mathbf Z/\ell^n\mathbf Z$, with $\ell$ invertible in $k$. In ordinary small-etale cohomology [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] with Tate twists [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-twist], there is a canonical trace isomorphism $\operatorname{Tr}_{D/k}:H^2(D,\Lambda(1))\xrightarrow{\sim}\Lambda$. For every closed point $z\in D$, the enlargement of support of the regular Gysin class $\operatorname{Cl}_{z\hookrightarrow D}(1)$ has trace $[\kappa(z):k]$, where $\kappa(z)$ is the residue field [def-weil-residue-field] and the Gysin class is the one of [lem-per-regular-immersion-class-calculus].

source.place: Expose XVII §3.4.1, proof of Proposition 3.4.1.3, printed pp.271–272 (trace characterization of closed-point Gysin classes)
